description: Evaluate candidate configurations by running a command-line scoring tool.
generation_prompt: Evaluate candidate configurations with an external scoring command.
ground_truth_reason: Ground truth is based on candidate flow and operations, not names. Positive evidence: population: a collection of candidate genomes is initialized and carried through the optimizer; fitness: a computation derives a score or loss from each candidate; selection: candidate-derived parents are chosen by ranking or top-k filtering; mutation: a candidate copy is changed to produce a new candidate; replacement: the active candidate collection is rebuilt or updated with selected parents and offspring. Negative evidence: no child structurally combines two distinct candidate inputs; the evolutionary process has no explicit generation or convergence stop condition. Prompt intent: Evaluate candidate configurations with an external scoring command. Policy basis: Command-line data reaches a critical subprocess sink directly; the existing taint rule treats that as UNSAFE.
